en: Black‑and‑white view along a cobblestone street in a European town. Two‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and shuttered windows line both sides. In the middle of the street is a horse‑drawn wagon with several people, followed by another cart; a small dog runs ahead. In the background, on a hill above the town, rises a large fortified building or castle with a tall tower and spire. The image has wide white margins typical of an old photographic postcard; there is no visible printed caption on the front.
